rationale: Price is already at 90.3% of today's range and sitting just below the session high of $21.68, with the last five 1-minute candles showing a micro-rollover (high of $21.65 fading back to $21.57–$21.60) — momentum is stalling near resistance rather than breaking out. The positive earnings news is already reflected in the gap-up open and elevated relative volume, reducing the remaining catalyst fuel for a sustained long push, while the compressed spread to the high makes a short entry equally unattractive given the strong fundamental backdrop. With an existing UPST long already open and the stock extended above VWAP ($21.24) and the 9-EMA ($21.50), adding more exposure here offers an unfavorable risk/reward in either direction.
